# Alu-On (אלו און)

> Alu-On is an Israeli building-envelope specialist based in Haifa, providing end-to-end engineering, manufacturing, and installation of aluminum cladding, Alucobond (ACP) composite panels, HPL exterior panels, and curtain wall systems for commercial and residential projects.

## Company Information
- [About Alu-On](https://alu-on.co.il/about/): Company background, engineering team, and mission.
- [Contact](https://alu-on.co.il/contact/): Office address in Haifa, phone (050-999-7753), and inquiry form.

## Products & Services
- [Aluminum Cladding](https://alu-on.co.il/aluminum/): Full aluminum facade cladding solutions — design, fabrication, and installation.
- [Alucobond / ACP Panels](https://alu-on.co.il/alucobond/): Composite aluminum panel systems for exterior facades.
- [HPL Exterior Panels](https://alu-on.co.il/hpl/): High-Pressure Laminate cladding for durable, weather-resistant exteriors.
- [Exterior Wall Cladding](https://alu-on.co.il/exterior-wall-cladding/): Hebrew guide to exterior wall cladding types (aluminum, Alucobond, HPL, curtain walls), comparison, cost factors and process.
- [Building Cladding in Haifa & the North](https://alu-on.co.il/haifa-building-cladding/): Haifa-based cladding services for Haifa, the Krayot and northern Israel, incl. coastal-climate considerations.
- [Curtain Wall Systems](https://alu-on.co.il/curtain-walls/): Structural glazing and curtain wall engineering.

- [Curtain Wall Spec Sheet](https://alu-on.co.il/specs/curtain-wall-spec.html): Technical specification for curtain wall systems.
